articles.title: Murder FIR on 10-yr-old girl for pushing toddler from sixth floor in Mumbai
articles.description: An 18-month-old toddler fell to her death from a sixth-floor stairwell in Goregaon. Police registered a murder FIR against her 10-year-old neighbor based on the mother's complaint. The child's mother stated that the older girl had gestured for her daughter to approach her. After the incident, the 10-year-old was placed in counseling through an NGO. Experts emphasize the importance of rehabilitation for the young girl rather than punitive measures.

articles.title: Avengers Assemble: From Captain America to Spider-Man, superheroes run wild in France
articles.description: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.

articles.title: Mother, lover, son kill 13-year-old twins who opposed their relationship
articles.description: In Badesra village, two twin brothers, Vinay and Vishnu Chaudhary, were found murdered on Tuesday morning. Their mother, Preeti, allegedly conspired with her paramour to kill them due to their opposition to her relationship. The police discovered the bodies showing multiple injuries, including slit throats and head wounds. Preeti's 16-year-old son also participated in the crime, supporting his mother.

articles.title: Dev Rai founded a nonprofit at 15; it has helped 400 artisans, sold 900 products and mobilised 300 volunteers
articles.description: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers. By creating essential connections between artisans and American consumers through community initiatives, Rai envisions a future where these artisans can thrive through digital platforms, enhancing cultural heritage while empowering youth in entrepreneurship and leadership roles.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu rain: Schools closed in Chennai and four other districts on October 21; check latest weather updates
articles.description: Schools in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu and Ranipet will remain closed on October 21, 2026, following heavy overnight rainfall in Tamil Nadu. Meenambakkam recorded 12 cm of rain, while Nungambakkam received 11 cm. The Regional Meteorological Centre has forecast further rainfall as a weather system develops over the Bay of Bengal. The IMD has issued orange alerts for Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi, where rainfall could reach 20 cm on October 21 and 22.

articles.title: HP Board registration deadline extended for Class 9, 10; correction window to open on November 17
articles.description: HPBOSE registration 2026-27: The Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education has set November 16, 2026, as the deadline for Class 9 and Class 10 registration for the 2026-27 academic session, with a late fee of Rs 500. A correction window will remain open from November 17 to November 25 for changes to student details and elective subjects. School principals will be responsible for incomplete registrations and errors. HPBOSE has also issued IT cell and district-wise helpline numbers for assistance.

articles.title: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026 to be released today at mppsc.mp.gov.in; check download steps and exam date
articles.description: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026: MPPSC ADPO admit card 2026 is scheduled for release on October 21, ahead of the revised written examination on November 1. The recruitment covers 107 Gazetted Class II vacancies under the Madhya Pradesh Home Department. The three-hour OMR-based examination carries 450 marks across general studies and law, with negative marking for incorrect answers. Candidates can download their hall tickets from the official MPPSC website using their application details and should verify their examination centre and entry requirements.

articles.title: 'Nayyi Navelli' Day 5: India net hits Rs 4.35 cr; worldwide gross nears Rs 24.68 cr
articles.description: Nayyi Navelli has made a remarkable jump in box office earnings, raking in Rs 4.35 crore on its fifth day in theaters, reflecting a substantial 64.2% increase from the previous day. After five days, its domestic net collection totals Rs 18.65 crore. The film, which delves into an intriguing family dynamic with Yami Gautam in the lead, has also amassed Rs 24.68 crore globally, resonating well with audiences.
